items.description: A string representing a protocol, such as HTTP or HTTPS.

protocols.description: A set of strings representing protocols.

model.description: Custom type for representing a foreign key with a null value allowed.

remember_cookie_name.description: Persistent session cookie name. Use with the `remember` configuration parameter.

remember_rolling_timeout.description: The persistent session rolling timeout window, in seconds.

logout_methods.description: A set of HTTP methods that the policy will respond to.

logout_post_arg.description: The POST argument passed to logout requests. Do not change this property.

store_metadata.description: Whether to also store metadata of sessions, such as collecting data of sessions for a specific audience belonging to a specific subject.

idling_timeout.description: The session cookie idle time, in seconds.

rolling_timeout.description: The session cookie rolling timeout, in seconds. Specifies how long the session can be used until it needs to be renewed.

stale_ttl.description: The duration, in seconds, after which an old cookie is discarded, starting from the moment when the session becomes outdated and is replaced by a new one.

cookie_same_site.description: Determines whether and how a cookie may be sent with cross-site requests.

cookie_http_only.description: Applies the `HttpOnly` tag so that the cookie is sent only to a server.

remember_absolute_timeout.description: The persistent session absolute timeout limit, in seconds.

audience.description: The session audience, which is the intended target application. For example `"my-application"`.

cookie_path.description: The resource in the host where the cookie is available.

bind.description: Bind the session to data acquired from the HTTP request or connection.

response_headers.description: List of information to include, as headers, in the response to the downstream.

logout_query_arg.description: The query argument passed to logout requests.

storage.description: Determines where the session data is stored. `kong`: Stores encrypted session data into Kong's current database strategy; the cookie will not contain any session data. `cookie`: Stores encrypted session data within the cookie itself.

absolute_timeout.description: The session cookie absolute timeout, in seconds. Specifies how long the session can be used until it is no longer valid.

cookie_domain.description: The domain with which the cookie is intended to be exchanged.

request_headers.description: List of information to include, as headers, in the response to the downstream.

hash_subject.description: Whether to hash or not the subject when store_metadata is enabled.

secret.description: The secret that is used in keyed HMAC generation.

cookie_secure.description: Applies the Secure directive so that the cookie may be sent to the server only with an encrypted request over the HTTPS protocol.

route.description: If set, the policy will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route. Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the route being used.

service.description: If set, the policy will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service. Leave unset for the policy to activate regardless of the Service being matched.
